policy.meaning_of_open: Declared license permits reuse, modification, and redistribution, including commercial use, subject to license obligations.
policy.readiness_note: svg-lucide is qualified for bounded acquisition at commit 70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934. Every other source stays explicitly unavailable: no connector is implemented for it and no upstream bytes were fetched.
policy.qualification_note: A source is qualified only when an implemented connector has fetched upstream bytes at a pinned immutable revision, verified per-record digests and archived the license notice at that revision. License eligibility alone never enables acquisition.
policy.budget_quantity_note: Dataset Bank acquisition budgets are reserved in the policy unit and settled with the number of verified upstream records transferred.

acquisition.revision_selection: main resolved to an immutable commit through the upstream Git reference API; acquisition always reads this exact commit.
acquisition.record_selection: deterministic evenly spaced slice of the sorted icons/*.svg inventory at the pinned commit
acquisition.measurement_environment: macOS arm64 laptop, CPython 3.12, HTTPS to raw.githubusercontent.com and api.github.com; the product deployment has not been exercised.

checks: Git reference API resolved main to commit 70562c1ee1c4fdcf736fe97bc893fb8511927934.
Recursive tree listing reported 1877 icons/*.svg blobs totalling 762249 bytes, not truncated.
120 evenly spaced records were fetched and every git blob SHA-1 recomputed from the downloaded bytes matched the tree listing.
The LICENSE blob at the pinned commit was fetched and its notice is archived with the published dataset.
